description: v4 only. Quote opening or increasing a leveraged position in one atomic order: the debt reserve is flash-loaned, swapped into the collateral reserve and supplied, and the debt is drawn against it to repay the flash loan. Both reserves are reserveIds from get_markets in this session, on the same spoke: pick a debtReserve whose 'quotableAs' lists leverageDebt and a collateralReserve whose 'quotableAs' lists leverageCollateral. Returns the quote with a quoteId (feeds preview_action and prepare_order), the approvals to sign first, and maxSafeMultiplier - the multiplier at which the position becomes liquidatable, which a requested multiplier must stay under. Nothing is committed until the user signs, so state the plan rather than asking permission to quote it.

additionalCollateral.description: Extra collateral pulled from the wallet (via permit) on top of existing collateral, in the collateral asset's main units. Required when the wallet has no existing collateral in that reserve; otherwise omit the argument entirely unless the user wants to top up.

collateralReserve.description: reserveId of the asset bought and supplied as collateral, from get_markets.

debtReserve.description: reserveId of the asset borrowed (flash-loaned, then owed as debt), from get_markets.

enableCollateral.description: Whether the supplied collateral backs borrowing (default true, which the leverage loop requires). Omit unless the user asked otherwise.

multiplier.description: Target exposure multiplier (target collateral / entry equity), e.g. '2.5'. Strictly greater than 1, and it must stay under the quote's maxSafeMultiplier. Omit the argument entirely to be quoted at a multiplier the backend picks from how closely the two assets track each other.

slippagePct.description: Optional max slippage as a percent string, e.g. '0.5'. Omit to accept the backend suggestion.

user.description: Wallet address (0x, 40 hex) of the wallet that will sign, as the user named it in this session. If no wallet has been named, ask for it; never substitute a placeholder, which is rejected.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.

name: get_leverage_quote
title: Quote a leveraged position (v4)
